hooks.name: Language check on save
hooks.description: When a file in src/ui/, data/cases/, docs/ or README.md is saved, run scripts/check-language.ts and report any hit (rules in .kiro/steering/language.md).

action.command: if out=$(node scripts/check-language.ts 2>&1); then echo "Language check passed."; else echo "Language check found banned wording (see .kiro/steering/language.md). Say \"below the IADC disposal threshold under the stated assumptions\" instead of judging:" >&2; printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 1; fi
